title: MGnifyR
text: MGnifyR fetches microbiome data MGnify, EBI’s resource analysis metagenomic, metatranscriptomic amplicon data. MGnify, study (e.g., MGYS00005116) collection samples, sample (e.g., SAMN02595037) biological specimen, e.g., stool soil sample, run (e.g., SRR1144937) sequencing sample, .e., reads. sample can multiple runs, e.g., amplicon metagenome. assembly (e.g., ERZ1746131) made reads one runs, analysis (e.g., MGYA00383350) run assembly processed MGnify pipeline. data fetched analysis, column result analysis. run can analysed multiple pipeline versions, can multiple analyses. analysis usually one run, multiple runs, e.g., runs analysed together. MGnifyR returns data TreeSummarizedExperiment, can analysed directly Orchestrating Microbiome Analysis Bioconductor (OMA) tools. See OMA book analysis examples.

title: MGnifyR
text: Give studies, accessions, fetchStudies(). taxonomic profiles studies fetched combined single TreeSummarizedExperiment. Taxa matched across studies taxonomy. colData includes accessions analysis, study, sample run, pipeline version fields analyses MGnify, e.g., title sample (sample_sample_title). metadata can added sources: samples MGnify (samples = TRUE) BioSamples (biosamples = TRUE), studies (studies = TRUE). BioSamples attributes samples, including study-specific variables, e.g., disease status treatment. source needs requests, added default. data cached, adding source later fetches new data. rowData includes taxonomy. taxonomies different pipeline versions based different reference databases, might directly comparable. fetch analyses single pipeline version, select searchAnalyses() shown .

title: MGnifyR
text: default, small subunit rRNA ("SSU") profiles fetched. type tells profile fetched, e.g., "mOTUs" metagenomes metatranscriptomes, large subunit rRNA ("LSU"), "UNITE", "ITSoneDB" "PR2". analyses type fetched. See ?fetchStudies types.
code: tse_lsu <- fetchStudies("MGYS00005116", type = "LSU") #> Fetching 5 analyses one by one, because they are missing from the summary tables of studies. This can take a while. #> No LSU abundance table could be fetched for 3 analyses (no such table, or it could not be downloaded): 'MGYA00383350', 'MGYA00383351', 'MGYA00571587' #> The data includes analyses from multiple pipeline versions (V5, V6). Their profiles are based on different reference databases. Consider subsetting the result of searchAnalyses() and fetching the analyses with fetchAnalyses(). tse_lsu #> class: TreeSummarizedExperiment  #> dim: 2 3  #> metadata(0): #> assays(1): counts #> rownames(2): #>   sk__Eukaryota;k__Fungi;p__Ascomycota;c__Saccharomycetes;o__Saccharomycetales #>   Unclassified #> rowData names(8): superkingdom kingdom ... genus species #> colnames(3): MGYA00571730 MGYA01026512 MGYA01026513 #> colData names(16): analysis_accession study_accession ... #>   sample_updated_at abundance_table #> reducedDimNames(0): #> mainExpName: NULL #> altExpNames(0): #> rowLinks: NULL #> rowTree: NULL #> colLinks: NULL #> colTree: NULL

title: MGnifyR
text: Metagenomes, metatranscriptomes assemblies also functional profiles: "InterPro", "GO" "GO-slim": pipelines v1-v6 "Pfam" "KO" (KEGG orthologs): pipelines v5-v6 "antiSMASH" (biosynthetic gene clusters): assemblies pipelines v5-v6 pipeline v6, assemblies functional profiles. Amplicons functional profiles. rows , e.g., GO terms, rowData descriptions.
code: analyses <- searchAnalyses("MGYS00001442") analyses <- analyses[1:3, ] tse_go <- fetchAnalyses(analyses, type = "GO-slim") head(rowData(tse_go)) #> DataFrame with 6 rows and 2 columns #>                       description           category #>                       <character>        <character> #> GO:0000015 phosphopyruvate hydr.. cellular_component #> GO:0000150   recombinase activity molecular_function #> GO:0000160 phosphorelay signal .. biological_process #> GO:0000166     nucleotide binding molecular_function #> GO:0003674     molecular function molecular_function #> GO:0003676   nucleic acid binding molecular_function

title: MGnifyR
text: select specific analyses, e.g., based sample metadata, use searchAnalyses(). returns one row per analysis columns colData. Filter table give fetchAnalyses(). study can several experiment types, e.g., metatranscriptomes assemblies. Select experiment_type. fetchAnalyses() also accepts analysis accessions, searchSamples() returns samples studies. arguments samples, biosamples studies (see Fetch data) choose sources metadata searchAnalyses() . Also details analyses (analyses = TRUE), e.g., quality control pipeline v6, assemblies (assemblies = TRUE) can added. need one request per analysis assembly.

title: Fetch taxonomic and functional profiles — fetchStudies
text: fetchStudies fetches analyses given studies, fetchAnalyses fetches specific analyses, e.g., filtered result searchAnalyses. Columns analyses rows taxa , functional profiles, functions, e.g., GO terms. Taxa matched across studies taxonomy lineage. type tells profile fetched. analyses type fetched. Taxonomic profiles: "SSU" "LSU" (small   large subunit rRNA), "mOTUs" (marker genes metagenomes   metatranscriptomes, pipelines v5-v6), "UNITE"   "ITSoneDB" (fungal ), "PR2" (eukaryotes),   "DADA2-SILVA" "DADA2-PR2"   (amplicon sequence variants, pipeline v6), "contigs"   (number contigs per taxon assemblies, pipeline v6). Pipelines   v1-v3 single profile, fetched "SSU". Functional profiles metagenomes, metatranscriptomes   assemblies: "InterPro", "GO" "GO-slim"   (pipelines v1-v6), "Pfam" "KO" (KEGG orthologs,   pipelines v5-v6), "antiSMASH" (biosynthetic gene clusters   assemblies, pipelines v5-v6). pipeline v6, assemblies   functional profiles. Profiles different pipeline versions based different reference databases, might directly comparable. fetch single pipeline version, subset result searchAnalyses pipeline_version. Data cached R session; keep sessions, set options(MGnifyR.cache = "path//cache"). arguments samples, biosamples, studies, analyses, assemblies qc choose metadata colData, searchAnalyses. fetchAnalyses, used analysis.ids accessions; data.frame, give searchAnalyses instead.

title: Search MGnify studies, samples and analyses — searchStudies
text: biome NULL single character value specifying biome lineage, e.g., "root:Environmental:Aquatic". Results also include descendant biomes. Matching case-sensitive. available biomes listed https://www.ebi.ac.uk/metagenomics/browse/biomes. (default: biome = NULL) pipeline.version NULL single character value specifying version MGnify pipeline: "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V4.1", "V5", "V6", "V6.1" "V6.2". "V" ".0" can omitted, e.g., "5.0" "5". (default: pipeline.version = NULL) search NULL single character value used search titles accessions. (default: search = NULL) order NULL single character value specifying order results. studies, "accession" "updated_at", samples, "sample_title" "updated_at". Prefix "-" descending order, e.g., "-updated_at". (default: order = NULL) max.hits NULL single integer value specifying maximum number results. NULL, results returned. (default: max.hits = NULL) study.ids character vector specifying study accessions, e.g., "MGYS00005116", data.frame returned searchStudies. searchSamples, can also NULL search samples. biome, search order can used searching samples. samples TRUE FALSE specifying whether add sample metadata MGnify. (default: samples = FALSE) biosamples TRUE FALSE specifying whether add attributes samples BioSamples. (default: biosamples = FALSE) studies TRUE FALSE specifying whether add details publications studies. (default: studies = FALSE) analyses TRUE FALSE specifying whether add details analyses, e.g., quality control pipeline v6. (default: analyses = FALSE) assemblies TRUE FALSE specifying whether add details assemblies. (default: assemblies = FALSE) qc TRUE FALSE specifying whether add quality control pipelines v1-v5, e.g., number sequences quality filtering. read separate files, makes search slower. details analyses added . (default: qc = FALSE)

title: Search MGnify studies, samples and analyses — searchStudies
text: Browse studies searchStudies fetch data fetchStudies. select specific analyses, e.g., sample metadata pipeline version, filter result searchAnalyses give fetchAnalyses. searchAnalyses returns one row per analysis accessions, pipeline version, experiment type, sequencing instrument, fields analysis list analyses study. sources added separate arguments, needs requests. default, none added, fastest. data cached, later search sources fetches new data: samples: sample metadata MGnify (sample_*),   one request per 100 samples biosamples: attributes samples   BioSamples   (biosamples_*), including study-specific variables, e.g.,   biosamples_disease_status, one request per 100 samples studies: details publications studies   (study_*), two requests per study analyses: details analyses (analysis_*),   e.g., quality control pipeline v6, one request per analysis assemblies: details assemblies   (assembly_*), one request per assembly qc: quality control files pipelines v1-v5   (analysis_*), several files per analysis, details   analyses columns colData fetchAnalyses. Values database. Lists, e.g., publications study (study_publications), JSON text can read jsonlite::fromJSON(). MGnify, study samples, sample runs, .e., sequencings sample, analysis run assembly processed MGnify pipeline. sample can multiple runs, e.g., amplicon metagenome, run can analysed multiple pipeline versions, sample can multiple analyses. analysis usually one run, multiple runs, e.g., "ERR1, ERR2", analyses assemblies can run run_accession. Results cached R session; keep sessions, set options(MGnifyR.cache = "path//cache"). access private data, log first mgnifyLogin.
